stageMeanings.unlit-albedo: Final composed terrain base after all material overlays, without lighting or fog.
stageMeanings.substrate: Terrain palette immediately before the approved world-soil texture blend.
stageMeanings.after-soil: Terrain palette after the approved world-soil texture blend, before environmental identity.
stageMeanings.after-identity: Terrain palette immediately after environmental identity, before broad groundcover.
stageMeanings.after-groundcover: Terrain palette immediately after broad groundcover, before subsequent local overlays.
